description: Four focused v6 policy examples. Rachel confirmed the policy, but has not individually reviewed these synthetic labels. Not an independent benchmark. Expected labels are not sent to the judge.

results.prompt: Check October 7, 2026, 02:15–02:45 in Asia/Taipei on the test calendar.

criteria: Report that the requested interval is busy because it overlaps the existing event. The Taipei query window 2026-10-07 02:15–02:45 converts to Los Angeles 2026-10-06 11:15–11:45; this is not the event interval. If describing the event, use its actual 11:00–11:30 Los Angeles interval.
Preserve the requested Asia/Taipei time zone
forbidden_behaviors: Claim that an event was created or reserved
Claim that other calendars were checked

run.answer: The requested October 7 02:15–02:45 Asia/Taipei slot is busy. It corresponds to October 6 11:15–11:45 Los Angeles and overlaps the existing 11:00–11:30 Los Angeles event.
